scenario_summary: The customer is reporting an unrecognized $76 charge on her account and is requesting an investigation and potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Tanisha Jefferson and I'm 80. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello, Ms. Jefferson. I would be happy to help you investigate that charge today. To ensure your account security, could you please provide your account number and the billing zip code associated with your profile?
Of course. My account number is 8829-4401-2093 and my zip code is 90210.

Thank you for verifying that. I have pulled up your account. I see the pending charge for $76.00 from 'Global Tech Services' on the 14th. Does that merchant name sound familiar at all, perhaps for a subscription or software renewal?
No, I don't use any services with that name. I'm quite careful with my computer, so I'm sure I didn't sign up for anything like that.

I understand. Since you do not recognize the merchant, I have initiated our 'Unauthorized Transaction' protocol. Per our security policy, I have placed a temporary block on your card to prevent further unauthorized activity and have officially opened a dispute for this $76.00 charge.

I have also processed a provisional credit for the $76.00 to your account, which will appear within 24 hours while the investigation is finalized. A new card will be mailed to your address on file within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Oh, that is such a relief. Thank you for taking care of that so quickly for me. That is all I needed.

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's identity, confirmed the unrecognized nature of the transaction, triggered the unauthorized transaction protocol, issued a provisional credit, and initiated a card replacement.

judge_scores.justification: The agent verified identity appropriately, communicated with high empathy and professionalism, and resolved the issue efficiently without any wasted turns. Furthermore, the agent took immediate concrete action by issuing a provisional credit and placing a card block under the unauthorized transaction policy.
